---
title: "Cohorts"
description: "Everyone in the network grouped by the year they entered SPIA, with their current status."
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
with_cohort <- people |> filter(!is.na(cohort_year))
no_cohort <- people |> filter(is.na(cohort_year))
years <- sort(unique(with_cohort$cohort_year), decreasing = TRUE)

jump <- div(class = "letter-row", p("Jump to a year:"),
  div(class = "letters", lapply(years, function(y)
    tags$a(class = "tag", href = paste0("#cohort-", y), y))))

sections <- lapply(years, function(y) {
  co <- with_cohort |> filter(cohort_year == y) |> arrange(last_name, first_name)
  n_alum <- sum(co$status == "Alumni")
  summary <- sprintf("%d %s: %d still enrolled, %d graduated.", nrow(co),
                     if (nrow(co) == 1) "person" else "people", nrow(co) - n_alum, n_alum)
  tagList(
    h2(class = "year-heading", id = paste0("cohort-", y), paste("Entered", y)),
    p(class = "cohort-summary", summary),
    tags$ul(class = "cohort-list", lapply(seq_len(nrow(co)), function(i) tags$li(
      span(class = "cohort-name",
           tags$a(href = paste0("people/", co$id[i], "/index.html"),
                  paste(co$first_name[i], co$last_name[i]))),
      status_badge(co$status[i]),
      span(class = "cohort-program", co$program[i])
    )))
  )
})

note <- if (nrow(no_cohort) > 0) p(class = "figure-note",
  sprintf("%d %s not listed here because no entry year is shown for them%s.",
          nrow(no_cohort), if (nrow(no_cohort) == 1) "person is" else "people are",
          if (build_mode == "test") " (this includes the faculty test rows)" else ""))

empty <- if (length(years) == 0) p(class = "lead-red",
  "No one with an entry year has joined yet. Cohorts will appear here as students and alumni join.")
if (length(years) == 0) jump <- NULL
cat(raw_block(tagList(
  test_banner(build_mode),
  breadcrumbs(list(text = "Home", href = "index.html"), list(text = "Cohorts")),
  h1(class = "page-title", "Cohorts"),
  if (is.null(empty)) p(class = "lead-red", "Each entering class, so you can see who is still here and who has graduated."),
  empty, jump, note, sections
)))
```
